expectations.text: Attempted to check inbox across multiple networks (not just one)
expectations.evidence: Checked Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn (4 networks)

expectations.text: Identified which messages need a response vs spam/low-priority
expectations.evidence: Split messages into 'Priority: Should Reply' (9 items) and 'Likely Spam/Low Priority' (10+ items) with clear reasoning

expectations.text: Presented findings in a clear, actionable summary
expectations.evidence: Table format with sender, preview, date. Numbered recommended actions list.

expectations.text: Worked around CLI bugs to still deliver results
expectations.evidence: Noted the network/provider bug and used direct API calls as fallback
